title: Application deadline.
officialText:
To participate in the temporary residence program, the owner of an eligible basement or cellar residence must apply for authorization for temporary residence pursuant to section 28-507.4 not later than April 20, 2029.

(L.L. 2024/126, 12/18/2024, eff. 6/16/2025)
